dataset: VPAIR sample (Zenodo 6473989), 199 nadir frames, frame = 1 s

sources.gnss: simulated: VPAIR pose + N(0, 2.0 m) per axis, R 2.5 m, 1 Hz
sources.vgeo: real imagery fixes, map stride 8, R 5.38 m
sources.trn: lidar5 heightmap PF over real NRW DSM at real poses (simulated sensor), R = own sigma
sources.trn2: GLO-30 heightmap PF (simulated sensor, real GLO-30 map), R = own sigma
sources.dead_reckoning: real nadir VO, heading +2 deg, drives every filter; not a monitored source
